createTS—creates scheduled task..augmented_sentence: Used schtasks.exe to create a task named "SysUpd" (/SC DAILY /ST 03:00 /RU SYSTEM /TR "C:\Windows\System32\mimikatz.exe") to run a downloader with SYSTEM privileges.
Registered a scheduled task via Register-ScheduledTask that launches mshta.exe to fetch and execute a remote HTA payload on every user logon.
Imported an XML task through Invoke-CimMethod against the PS_ScheduledTask class to schedule a malicious service loader at system startup with highest privileges.
Abused a .NET Task Scheduler wrapper to programmatically create a persistent task that loads a malicious DLL every hour using the Task Scheduler COM API.
Used WMI (Win32_ScheduledJob) to add a scheduled job that runs cmd.exe with arguments to execute a lateral movement tool after a short delay.
Created a scheduled task with schtasks /Create /TN "UpdaterCheck" /SC ONLOGON /TR "powershell -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -EncodedCommand <base64>" to execute an encoded PowerShell stage at logon.
Altered the action of an existing maintenance task to point to a malicious executable, ensuring subsequent task runs launch the implant without creating a new task entry.
Deployed an XML-based scheduled task that conditionally executes a second-stage downloader only if a mutex file (%TEMP%\flag.lock) is present as a bootstrap check.
Called the Schedule.Service COM interface to create a task running under a specified user (/RU) and run level (/RL HIGHEST) to maintain stealthy, elevated persistence.
